items.period: Shang dynasty, oracle-bone script (approximate period label; specific Xiaoxuetang source entry 42.F100)
items.caption: A modern vector redraw labeled as Shang oracle-script 年; the linked source identifies a Xiaoxuetang form record.
items.alt: Modern drawn oracle-script form of 年, with a grain-like upper element above a human-shaped lower element.
items.selection_reason: Shows the early form discussed by the museum and database, with page-level attribution to a specific Xiaoxuetang record and an explicit reuse notice.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 for the sourced Xiaoxuetang glyph image; Commons page also states public-domain status for its modern vector representation. Modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 年 in the Shuowen seal-script style, a useful comparison for the later 千-shaped lower element.
items.alt: Modern seal-script drawing of 年 with a grain-like upper element and a lower element represented in the small-seal tradition.
items.selection_reason: Pairs with the oracle-form candidate to illustrate the database’s reported lower-element change while keeping the seal form identified as a later dictionary tradition.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 for the sourced Xiaoxuetang glyph image; Commons page also states public-domain status for its modern vector representation. Modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

limitations.text: Both selected glyphs are modern vector redrawings of historical script forms; neither is a photograph of an inscribed Shang object. The oracle candidate’s page gives source-record attribution, but the individual Xiaoxuetang record was not inspected directly in readable form.
The exact file page for 年-bronze-shang.svg could not be fetched by the browser, and the generic Late Shang tracing inspected is not identified specifically as 年; no bronze image is selected.
